mechanism: Run-ranked exact exceptions against the last completed same-template-name and explicit-key value
decision: Do not implement this exact donor/mask realization on these populations
proof: Choose r positive run lengths summing to e, then distribute n-e zeros across two unrestricted end gaps and r-1 positive internal gaps. These choices are in bijection with the masks. Rank/unrank requires ceil(log2 M) bits for fixed n,e,r.
method: Parse stored WRT and dictionary; verify reconstructed raw bytes and every trace truth byte against stored[10:].
Scan outer templates with the retained parser. Route is exact template name plus explicit key; no normalization. Require holes to meet complete WRT-emission boundaries.
Install the donor only after its entire source invocation closes. Current and donor values are at most 512 WRT bytes. Compare their common-length prefix; unmatched suffix stays literal.
For each pair charge one mode bit and unsigned LEB128 current length, exception count and exception-run count, plus log2 M mask bits. Credit only parent ideal Q16 cost on exactly matching bytes.
Binary64 logarithms are diagnostic. Finite rank rounding, termination, source, dictionary and router costs are omitted, making the screen optimistic. This is not an exact archive bound.
scope_limit: No extrapolation or broad-family futility follows. Cold absence does not reject a mechanism requiring more causal history. The separately requested block/schema codec is a different realization.
future_controls: If a different frozen population pays: fully charged forced-literal replay and one-position rotated prior donor; preserve all parent updates and verify exact inverse, repeat and parent state after regenerated bytes.
